name: service-key-persistence-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): plants a service-key finding, demand-start only so the box stays stable. MODE=imagepath redirects a service's ImagePath to a PowerShell payload (the legit binary is left at LEGIT_PATH); MODE=unquoted writes an unquoted ImagePath containing a space; MODE=servicedll creates a svchost service and puts PAYLOAD_PATH under Parameters\ServiceDll; MODE=failurecommand sets FailureCommand to a payload. Vars: SERVICE_NAME (required); MODE (required); LEGIT_PATH (required for imagepath/unquoted; copied from svchost.exe if it does not exist); PAYLOAD_PATH / PAYLOAD_BODY (required for imagepath/servicedll/failurecommand; written when BODY supplied); DISPLAY_NAME (optional). Idempotent: an existing same-named service is stopped and deleted first. The hardened state is the ImagePath restored/quoted, or the ServiceDll/FailureCommand value removed -- every check reads the registry, not the service state.
